method: Manual strict local-file review against chain_gold.json and candidate run JSON. No OpenAI/API scorer used. Gold items scored subject/action/object/critical_evidence as 0/1.
judge_summary: The candidate recovers the core cmd.exe /c start_dns_logs.bat execution and gives explorer.exe as parent context for the cmd.exe process, but it collapses the explorer launch and batch execution into one candidate step and does not provide the required CBC parent_path evidence. It also mentions tshark.exe under cmd.exe only as an inferred/weak child-process link with no CBC childproc/object evidence. The batch execution step is strong; parent-launch evidence and tshark evidence are strict zeros.
